retained_failures: The original scalar and byte modes both fail the native ASan check because a nested cache pointer-array default initializes slot zero with a stack address. The standalone constructor did not reproduce it; the nested-owner regression fails before the fix and passes after removal of the explicit default. All native checks are repeated after the fix. Generated-C probes are diagnostic only; the stopped costly full-DWARF build receives no validation credit.

The first whole-URL selection combined a process-wide file-origin-policy test with tests requiring the default policy. Its child process correctly changed that policy and other selected tests then failed. The final selection isolates that test without changing its assertions; all final jobs pass.

The preliminary component summary accidentally included a diagnostic-control observation. Both the original summary and a correction computed from the unchanged four unprofiled raw observations remain retained. No observation was dropped or repeated for the correction.

The initial component cohorts used arena poisoning in both modes. The final unpoisoned cohort uses the same executable and checks with production allocation behavior. All prior raw observations remain retained; no component or page credit is assigned to a change in measurement conditions.

The preliminary benchmark used a workspace per repetition, dominating short-input costs. The final benchmark amortizes workspace setup/retirement across 64 repetitions; both versions and raw results remain retained. This measurement-boundary change receives no engine optimization credit.
qualification: The byte encoder escapes the original bytes for valid UTF-8, with exact-sized owned output and an owned clone for unchanged ASCII. Malformed UTF-8 retains the original rune decoder and its replacement semantics. All nine encode sets, both space policies, every ASCII byte, Unicode boundaries, malformed sequences, random scalar sequences and input-arena retirement are covered. All URL, DOMURL and URL binding selections pass in both encoder modes under poisoned preallocation, ordinary GC, no GC and C-O0 ASan/UBSan. Components use production C-O3 and exact rune-based output oracles; malformed UTF-8 regresses and remains retained. The fixed nested cache initialization is shared by both encoder modes; it receives no percent-encoder performance attribution. No component result establishes page, live-site, rendering, scrolling or Brave acceptance.
